correctness.rationale: The monotone occupation functional A_t=mu int_0^t e^{mu s} 1_{sigma_s=-1} ds characterizes first entry exactly. Its stationary two-sided convolution B_t solves zero-flux telegraph stationarity with Beta(q/mu,q/mu) marginal. The pathwise bound 0≤B_t-U_t≤e^{-mu t} yields for every s the survival sandwich between Z=-log Beta/mu and Z+log(1+1/C)/mu, hence quantile and Wasserstein-infinity bound. Differentiating beta integrals gives gamma-ratio Laplace transform and moments. Exact no-switch trajectory gives fastest-entry atom of mass 1/2(1+C)^(-alpha). The condition C>=1, fair initial sign and no thermal noise are essential.
residual_risks: Monte Carlo is supplementary; result does not treat biased switching, first passage to origin or joint limits.
